system.description:
You swing your weapon low, in an attempt to hobble the enemy. Male a melee Taijutsu Attack targeting a creature in range. On a hit you deal your weapons damage+3d8.

Chain 1: Affected creatures speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of their next turn as you cut at their ankles.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
